source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates, table B01003 (Total Population), via censusreporter.org API
note: Neighborhood populations are ZCTA-based approximations: each neighborhood is assigned the population of its mapped ZCTA(s) (mapping mirrors lib/geocode.ts). A ZCTA is larger than the 1-mile scoring circle, so per-capita hazard is approximate; this limitation is disclosed in the published methodology. Neighborhoods with no ZCTA mapping fall back to area-based density with lowered confidence.
